steps.code:
# Parse the old_songs.txt content to extract song titles and artists
import re

content = file_data['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line if it's a comment (# Archived Songs)
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
    match = re.match(r'^- (.+) by (.+)$', line)
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artists_str = match.group(2).strip()
        # Split artists by comma
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        songs_to_archive.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists})
    else:
        print(f"Could not parse line: {line}")

print(f"Parsed {len(songs_to_archive)} songs to archive")
for s in songs_to_archive:
    print(s)

# Get all playlists from Spotify library
access_token = spotify_login['access_token']
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    playlists_page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not playlists_page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(playlists_page)
    if len(playlists_page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total playlists found: {len(all_playlists)}")
for p in all_playlists:
    print(f"ID: {p['playlist_id']}, Title: {p['title']}, Songs: {p['song_ids']}")
